subject: trouble with function ctmm.select and ctmm.fit

messages.author: bf658f30c122b191
messages.subject: trouble with function ctmm.select and ctmm.fit
parts:
Hi everybody,

I am working with data collected in Colombia, and I'm trying to calculate a home range for two groups per year. I have my data in class 'telemetry' with 6 groups as individuals.

When I try to apply ctmm.select and ctmm.fit I always got this error, what am I doing wrong? thank you all!

Error: $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors In addition: Warning messages: 1: In ctmm.loglike(data, CTMM, REML = REML, zero = -zero, profile = profile) : Duplicate timestamps require an error model. 2: In ctmm.loglike(data, CTMM, REML = REML, zero = -zero, profile = profile) : Duplicate timestamps require an error model. 3: In ctmm.loglike(data, CTMM, REML = REML, zero = -zero, profile = profile) : Duplicate timestamps require an error model. 4: In ctmm.loglike(data, CTMM, REML = REML, zero = -zero, profile = profile) : Duplicate timestamps require an error model. 5: In ctmm.loglike(data, CTMM, REML = REML, zero = -zero, profile = profile) : Duplicate timestamps require an error model. 6: In ctmm.loglike(data, CTMM, REML = REML, verbose = TRUE, profile = profile) : Duplicate timestamps require an error model.

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: trouble with function ctmm.select and ctmm.fit
parts:
Hi Nathalia,

If I am interpreting this correctly and you have a group of individuals (each with distinct locations at a given time) in a single telemetry object, then you need to break those up into individual telemetry objects.

Best,
Chris
